decisions.reason: Escalation pressure from sunk costs and the product's public listing as a core handle family has only increased since 2024, making withdrawal unlikely absent failure.
The mitred handle family remains central to the architectural range and publicly committed, so management will continue to justify its prior investment by keeping it.
Its alignment with the announced electronic access direction and public commitment make dropping very unlikely despite any temporary setbacks.
As part of the coordinated system promise with prior investment, management is likely to persist to avoid admitting failure.
The design award and dedicated page signal visible success and strong public commitment, so withdrawal is extremely unlikely.
